history.summary: A 3,401sqft freehold 4BR in D20 Bright Hill at $4.2M — the $1,235 PSF looks like a deep discount to the $2,063 median, but on only 8 transactions and an enormous unit, so the comparison is unreliable. 260m to Bright Hill MRT is excellent, but a $4.2M quantum for a 1996 mega-unit has an extremely thin exit pool.
history.rating_rationale: The headline value (PSF 1235 vs 2063 median) is a mirage: 8 URA txns can't be trusted, and the $2,063 median almost certainly reflects much smaller units — a 3,401sqft penthouse-scale unit transacts at a structurally lower PSF, so the discount is largely a size effect, not a bargain. The $4.2M absolute price sits far outside any deep buyer band; freehold and a superb 260m-to-Bright Hill-MRT location are real, but liquidity at this quantum/size/age (built 1996) is the overriding investment risk for a 5-7yr hold.
red_flags: $4.2M quantum — very thin buyer pool; near-impossible to exit quickly
3,401sqft oversized unit — cheap PSF is a size effect, not value
Only 8 URA transactions — appreciation rate unreliable
catalysts: 260m to Bright Hill MRT (Thomson-East Coast Line) — strong connectivity
